title: NT-to-DOS namespace boundary
contracts: SbieDll_TranslateNtToDosPath owns caller-visible path presentation for known NT to DOS mappings
MS-DOS device names are object-namespace junctions and can be local or global
drive-letter and DOS-device mappings must come from known namespace links, not arbitrary textual replacement
hidden Sandboxie NT box roots may be projected to the configured caller-visible DOS box root
MUP NT paths may be projected to UNC-like caller-visible paths
generic NT device paths must not be rewritten to Win32 device paths without a proven DOS-device mapping
the disabled Device-to-dot-device fallback remains disabled
this SREV changes comments and proof only
local_edges: File_GetDriveForPath / File_GetDriveForUncPath -> drive or UNC presentation
runtime_gate: Windows path-presentation matrix for DOS-prefix, MUP/UNC, hidden box-root, drive-letter, unmapped NT device, and Chrome crash-handler cases
